result.instructions: Tools for Logiwa, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which stock lines are at or below 10 units right now?"; "Which shipment orders due in the last week have not shipped yet?"; "How many orders were placed and shipped in the first half of November?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Logiwa data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run logiwa_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run logiwa_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run logiwa_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. logiwa_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: logiwa_list_low_stock_items
tools.title: List low-stock items
tools.description: Read one page of warehouse inventory lines and list the lines whose available quantity is at or below a threshold. Read only. It checks only the page you ask for; use page_index to read the next page. Logiwa: GET /v3.1/Inventory/list/i/{index}/s/{size}.

max_available.description: List lines with available quantity at or below this number (default 10).

page_size.description: Lines to read on this page, 1 to 200 (default 200).

tools.name: logiwa_list_overdue_shipments
tools.title: List overdue shipments
tools.description: Read one page of shipment orders due in a date range and list the orders that are past their expected shipment date, not yet shipped and not cancelled. The date is UTC. Read only. Logiwa: GET /v3.1/ShipmentOrder/list/i/{index}/s/{size} with ExpectedShipmentDate.bt.

expected_from.description: First expected shipment date in the range, as YYYY-MM-DD.

expected_to.description: Last expected shipment date in the range, as YYYY-MM-DD.

page_size.description: Lines to read on this page, 1 to 200 (default 100).

tools.name: logiwa_fulfillment_summary
tools.title: Summarise fulfillment counts
tools.description: Count the shipment orders placed in a date range and the orders shipped in a date range, optionally for one warehouse. Returns counts only, no order details. Read only. Logiwa: two GET /v3.1/ShipmentOrder/list calls with ShipmentOrderDate.bt and ActualShipmentDate.bt.

from.description: First day of the period, as YYYY-MM-DD.

to.description: Last day of the period, as YYYY-MM-DD.

warehouse_identifier.description: Warehouse GUID to limit the counts to one warehouse.
